sql.where: tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId}

mapper.select: SELECT id,report_name,report_key,shared,config_json,updated_at FROM tm_test_analytics_report WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND owner_id=#{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id,report_name,report_key,shared,config_json,updated_at,(SELECT display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=r.owner_id AND u.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS owner_name FROM tm_test_analytics_report r WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND shared=1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT scope_code,scope_name,function_type,importance,invalidated,created_at FROM tm_test_scope AND deleted=0 ORDER BY scope_code LIMIT 1000
SELECT case_code,case_name,case_type,priority,invalidated,created_at FROM tm_test_case AND deleted=0 ORDER BY case_code LIMIT 1000

SELECT e.id,c.case_code,c.case_name,e.execution_status,e.executed_at FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_case c ON c.id=e.case_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.test_domain=#{domain} AND e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND e.round_id=#{roundId} AND e.cycle_id=#{cycleId} ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT defect_code,summary,defect_category,severity,priority,urgency,status,proposed_at FROM tm_test_defect AND deleted=0 AND round_id=#{roundId} AND cycle_id=#{cycleId} ORDER BY proposed_at DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_analytics_report WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND owner_id=#{userId} AND report_name=#{name}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_analytics_report WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND owner_id=#{userId}
SELECT id,report_name,report_key,shared,config_json,updated_at FROM tm_test_analytics_report WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tm_test_analytics_report SET report_name=#{name},report_key=#{reportKey},config_json=#{configJson} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
UPDATE tm_test_analytics_report SET shared=#{shared},published_by=#{userId} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tm_test_analytics_report WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tm_test_round WHERE id=#{roundId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tm_test_analytics_snapshot(id,tenant_id,test_domain,project_id,round_id,report_key,snapshot_json,archived_by) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{domain},#{projectId},#{roundId},#{reportKey},#{snapshotJson},#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot_json=VALUES(snapshot_json),archived_by=VALUES(archived_by),archived_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id,round_id,report_key,archived_at,(SELECT display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=s.archived_by AND u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0) AS archiver_name FROM tm_test_analytics_snapshot s WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND round_id=#{roundId} ORDER BY archived_at DESC

SELECT defect_category AS dimension,COUNT(*) AS value FROM tm_test_defect WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} GROUP BY defect_category ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.display_name,'未分配') AS dimension,COUNT(*) AS value FROM tm_test_defect d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=d.handler_id AND u.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.test_domain=#{domain} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.short_name,''),REPLACE(p.name,'物理子系统','')) AS dimension,COUNT(e.id) AS execution_total,SUM(e.execution_status='SUCCESS') AS success_count,SUM(e.execution_status='FAILED') AS failed_count,SUM(e.execution_status='BLOCKED') AS blocked_count FROM tm_test_participating_system s JOIN arch_physical_subsystem p ON p.id=s.physical_subsystem_id LEFT JOIN tm_test_execution e ON e.physical_subsystem_id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.test_domain=#{domain} AND e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND e.round_id=#{roundId} AND e.cycle_id=#{cycleId} WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.enabled=1 AND s.deleted=0 AND s.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} GROUP BY s.physical_subsystem_id,p.name,p.short_name ORDER BY dimension
SELECT id,round_name,planned_start_date,planned_end_date,status FROM tm_test_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_no,id

SELECT c.id,c.round_id,c.cycle_name,c.planned_start_date,c.planned_end_date,c.status FROM tm_test_cycle c JOIN tm_test_round r ON r.id=c.round_id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.test_domain=#{domain} AND r.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.deleted=0 AND r.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.sort_no,c.id

SELECT o.option_code,o.option_name FROM tm_test_dictionary_option o JOIN tm_test_dictionary x ON x.id=o.dictionary_id AND x.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND x.test_domain=#{domain} AND x.project_id=#{projectId} AND x.dictionary_code=#{dictionaryCode} AND x.deleted=0 AND o.deleted=0 AND o.enabled=1 ORDER BY o.sort_no,o.id

SELECT report_key,snapshot_json,archived_at FROM tm_test_analytics_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND round_id=#{roundId} ORDER BY report_key
SELECT round_name FROM tm_test_round WHERE id=#{roundId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ps.short_name,''),REPLACE(ps.name,'物理子系统','')) AS dimension,COUNT(s.id) AS scope_total,SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_case c WHERE c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.scope_id=s.id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.invalidated=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS covered_total,SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tm_test_case c WHERE c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.scope_id=s.id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.invalidated=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncovered_total FROM tm_test_scope s JOIN tm_test_participating_system part ON part.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND part.test_domain=s.test_domain AND part.project_id=s.project_id AND part.physical_subsystem_id=s.physical_subsystem_id AND part.enabled=1 AND part.deleted=0 JOIN arch_physical_subsystem ps ON ps.id=s.physical_subsystem_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.test_domain=#{domain} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.invalidated=0 AND s.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} GROUP BY s.physical_subsystem_id,ps.name,ps.short_name ORDER BY dimension

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ps.short_name,''),REPLACE(ps.name,'物理子系统','')) AS dimension,COUNT(e.id) AS execution_total,SUM(e.execution_status='UNEXECUTED') AS unexecuted_count,SUM(e.execution_status='RUNNING') AS running_count,SUM(e.execution_status='SUCCESS') AS success_count,SUM(e.execution_status='FAILED') AS failed_count,SUM(e.execution_status='BLOCKED') AS blocked_count FROM tm_test_execution e JOIN tm_test_participating_system part ON part.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND part.test_domain=e.test_domain AND part.project_id=e.project_id AND part.physical_subsystem_id=e.physical_subsystem_id AND part.enabled=1 AND part.deleted=0 JOIN arch_physical_subsystem ps ON ps.id=e.physical_subsystem_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.test_domain=#{domain} AND e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND e.round_id=#{roundId} AND e.cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY e.physical_subsystem_id,ps.name,ps.short_name ORDER BY dimension

SELECT DATE(COALESCE(executed_at,created_at)) AS dimension,SUM(execution_status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','BLOCKED')) AS completed_count FROM tm_test_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND round_id=#{roundId} AND cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(executed_at,created_at)) ORDER BY dimension

choose.when: SELECT severity AS row_dimension,urgency AS column_dimension,COUNT(*) AS value FROM tm_test_defect AND deleted=0 AND round_id=#{roundId} AND cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY severity,urgency

SELECT defect_code,summary,status,(SELECT display_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=d.handler_id AND u.tenant_id=d.tenant_id) AS handler_name,DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE,DATE(proposed_at)) AS overdue_days FROM tm_test_defect d WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.test_domain=#{domain} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0 AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED') AND d.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND d.round_id=#{roundId} AND d.cycle_id=#{cycleId} ORDER BY overdue_days DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ps.short_name,''),REPLACE(ps.name,'物理子系统','')) AS dimension,COUNT(*) AS value FROM tm_test_defect d JOIN arch_physical_subsystem ps ON ps.id=d.physical_subsystem_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.test_domain=#{domain} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND d.round_id=#{roundId} AND d.cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY d.physical_subsystem_id,ps.name,ps.short_name ORDER BY value DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT statusdefect_categoryseverity AS dimension,COUNT(*) AS value FROM tm_test_defect AND deleted=0 AND round_id=#{roundId} AND cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY value DESC

mapper.select: SELECT DATE(proposed_at) AS dimension,COUNT(*) AS raised_count,SUM(status IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')) AS resolved_count FROM tm_test_defect WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND test_domain=#{domain} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 AND physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND round_id=#{roundId} AND cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY DATE(proposed_at) ORDER BY dimension

choose.when: SELECT COALESCE(u.display_name,'待分派') AS dimension,COUNT(d.id) AS handled_defects,SUM(d.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')) AS pending_defects FROM tm_test_defect d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=d.handler_id AND u.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.test_domain=#{domain} AND d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND d.round_id=#{roundId} AND d.cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY handled_defects DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT COALESCE(u.display_name,'未执行') AS dimension,COUNT(e.id) AS execution_total,SUM(e.execution_status='SUCCESS') AS success_count,SUM(e.execution_status='FAILED') AS failed_count,SUM(e.execution_status='RUNNING') AS running_count,SUM(e.execution_status='UNEXECUTED') AS unexecuted_count FROM tm_test_execution e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.executor_id AND u.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.test_domain=#{domain} AND e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.deleted=0 AND e.physical_subsystem_id=#{systemId} AND e.round_id=#{roundId} AND e.cycle_id=#{cycleId} GROUP BY u.display_name ORDER BY execution_total DESC
